page.overview:
Who is Davin?

is an older dwarf from Westruun. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Davin is an elderly, crotchety, half-blind, one clouded eye dwarf. He is wrinkled and his hair was bright white.

Davin is very crotchety and blunt. He demanded to be fed and let out before any other prisoners in .

Davin was thrown in the Iron Stocks for an unknown reason, but was drunk at the time he was arrested.
